'''Iagin Handar''' is a [[Defender of the Stone]] in [[Tear]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is stocky, with a puckered scar across his face.

== Activities ==
He was one of the Defenders that fought against the [[Trollocs]] when they attacked the [[Stone of Tear]]. He received his scar from that battle. He is guarding the [[Heart of the Stone]] and greets [[Rand al'Thor]], when Rand [[Travel]]s to Tear to meet with [[Darlin Sisnera]].
